entities.name: Khoja Marjanli Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Khoja Marjanli Mosque was a former Shia Islam mosque, now in ruins, located in Shusha, in the Karabakh district of Azerbaijan. It is located on Mirza Alakbar Sabir street of Khoja Marjanli neighborhood of Shusha, approximately 350 km (220 mi) from Baku, the capital.
